notices: This update changes your database to a new format. You cannot undo it: GoAhead v0.41 and earlier cannot open your data after the update. GoAhead does not make a backup. To keep a way back, copy your GoAhead data folder before you update.
The first start after the update can need free disk space of about two times the size of your database.
macOS can ask for access to Calendar and Reminders when a command that an agent runs uses them.
The width of the browser panels and the sidebar view go back to their defaults.
GoAhead makes new remote-desktop credentials each time it starts.

items: GoAhead now includes the features of OpenBot v0.77: Workflows, more than one conversation per agent, a Library page, the Vault, voice, new providers, the agent dock, Settings > Keyboard and a sidebar filter.
A routine can run one time.
A turn stops after 40 tool calls or about 3 million tokens and asks you to continue. Change this in Agent settings > Tool calls per turn.
GoAhead asks before an agent runs a command that installs large tools, such as a simulator runtime or pod install.
Claude and Codex agents compact their conversation at 120,000 tokens by default.
A turn that a teammate or a routine starts runs on the smaller model of the provider.
Settings > Storage lists folders that no agent uses and can move them to the Trash.
